Simulate some points in 2D:

```{r}
f1 <- function(x) 4*sin(0.5*pi * x)
f2 <- function(x) 3*log(x + 0.1) * sin(0.3*pi * x)

set.seed(123)
n <- 3000
t <- seq(0, 2, length.out = n)
x1 <- f1(t) + rnorm(n, sd = 0.1)
x2 <- f2(t) + rnorm(n, sd = 0.1)
X <- cbind(x1, x2)
```


```{r}
plot(X, pch = 16, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.5),
     xlab = "X1", ylab = "X2", main = "Simulated 2D Data")
```

Compute the first PC and project the data onto it:

```{r}
svd_res <- svd(X, nv = 1, nu = 1)
beta <- svd_res$v[, 1]
loadings <- svd_res$u[, 1] * svd_res$d[1]
```

Draw the first PC direction, and color points by their loadings:

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

df <- data.frame(
  X1      = X[, 1],
  X2      = X[, 2],
  loading = loadings
)

# scale loadings to stay between 0 and 1
df$loading <- df$loading - min(df$loading)
df$loading <- df$loading / max(abs(df$loading))

ggplot(df, aes(x = X1, y = X2, color = loading)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = beta[1] * 3, yend = beta[2] * 3),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm")),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    name = "PC loadings",
    option = "plasma",
    begin = 0, end = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "X1",
    y = "X2",
    title = "First Principal Component"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )
```

Using P-curve:

```{r}
library(princurve)
pc_fit <- principal_curve(as.matrix(X), maxit = 100, smoother = "smooth_spline", thresh = 1e-10)

df_p <- data.frame(
  X1     = X[, 1],
  X2     = X[, 2],
  lambda = pc_fit$lambda
)

df_p$lambda_scaled <- (df_p$lambda - min(df_p$lambda)) /
                      (max(df_p$lambda) - min(df_p$lambda))

curve_df <- data.frame(
  X1     = pc_fit$s[, 1],
  X2     = pc_fit$s[, 2],
  lambda = df_p$lambda_scaled
)
curve_df <- curve_df[order(curve_df$lambda), ]

library(grid)  

ggplot(df_p, aes(x = X1, y = X2, color = lambda_scaled)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_path(
    data = curve_df,
    aes(x = X1, y = X2),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 1.0,
    color = "black",
    arrow = arrow(
      length = unit(0.2, "cm"),
      ends   = "last",   
      type   = "closed"
    )
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    name = "p-curve index",
    option = "plasma",
    begin = 0, end = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "X1",
    y = "X2",
    title = "Principal Curve"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )
```


```{r}
set.seed(123)
iters <- seq(1, 50, by = 1)
fit_list <- lapply(iters, function(k) {
  principal_curve(
    as.matrix(X),
    maxit  = k,
    smoother = "smooth_spline",
    trace    = FALSE,
    thresh   = 1e-8
  )
})
names(fit_list) <- paste0("iter = ", iters)
curve_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(fit_list), function(j) {
  fit <- fit_list[[j]]
  data.frame(
    X1       = fit$s[, 1],
    X2       = fit$s[, 2],
    lambda   = fit$lambda,
    iter_lab = names(fit_list)[j]
  )
}))

curve_df <- curve_df[order(curve_df$iter_lab, curve_df$lambda), ]
df_p <- data.frame(X1 = X[, 1], X2 = X[, 2])
```

```{r}
# install.packages("gganimate")
library(gganimate)
library(ggplot2)

curve_df$iter_num <- as.integer(gsub("iter = ", "", curve_df$iter_lab))

p_anim <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = df_p,
    aes(x = X1, y = X2),
    color = "grey70", size = 0.4, alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_path(
    data = curve_df,
    aes(x = X1, y = X2, group = 1),
    color = "black", linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    x = "X1",
    y = "X2",
    title = "Principal Curve Fitting (iteration: {current_frame})"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  transition_manual(iter_num)   

anim <- gganimate::animate(
  p_anim,
  nframes  = length(unique(curve_df$iter_num)),  # 50
  fps      = 5,
  renderer = gifski_renderer()
)

gganimate::anim_save("pcurve_iterations.gif", animation = anim)
```


```{r}
# 取一小部分点来画 projection（例如 300 个）
set.seed(1)
idx_sample <- sample(seq_len(nrow(X)), size = 300)

# 曲线数据：每个 iteration 有两个 phase：
# "iter 01 - project" 和 "iter 01 - smooth"
curve_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(fit_list), function(j) {
  fit  <- fit_list[[j]]
  it   <- iters[j]
  base <- data.frame(
    X1     = fit$s[, 1],
    X2     = fit$s[, 2],
    lambda = fit$lambda
  )
  rbind(
    transform(base, frame_lab = sprintf("iter %02d - project", it)),
    transform(base, frame_lab = sprintf("iter %02d - smooth",  it))
  )
}))

# 按 frame + lambda 排序，画 path 时不会乱连
curve_all <- curve_all[order(curve_all$frame_lab, curve_all$lambda), ]


# 投影线段：只在 "project" phase 显示
segments_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(fit_list), function(j) {
  fit  <- fit_list[[j]]
  it   <- iters[j]
  data.frame(
    x      = X[idx_sample, 1],
    y      = X[idx_sample, 2],
    xend   = fit$s[idx_sample, 1],
    yend   = fit$s[idx_sample, 2],
    id     = idx_sample,
    frame_lab = sprintf("iter %02d - project", it)  # 只在 project 阶段存在
  )
}))

# 固定坐标范围，避免帧间抖动
xr <- range(df_p$X1)
yr <- range(df_p$X2)

p_anim_proj <- ggplot() +
  # 原始数据点（灰）
  geom_point(
    data = df_p[idx_sample,],
    aes(x = X1, y = X2),
    color = "grey80", size = 0.4, alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  # 曲线（黑）
  geom_path(
    data = curve_all,
    aes(x = X1, y = X2, group = 1),
    color = "black", linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  # 投影线段（蓝），只在 "project" 帧出现
  geom_segment(
    data = segments_all,
    aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend, group = id),
    color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  coord_equal(xlim = xr, ylim = yr) +
  labs(
    x = "X1",
    y = "X2",
    title = "Principal Curve Fitting (step: {current_frame})"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  # 每一帧就是一个明确的 step（iter k - project / iter k - smooth）
  transition_manual(frame_lab)

# 帧数 = 不同 step 的个数，即 2 * length(iters)
nf <- length(unique(curve_all$frame_lab))

anim_proj <- gganimate::animate(
  p_anim_proj,
  nframes  = nf,
  fps      = 5,
  renderer = gifski_renderer()
)

gganimate::anim_save("pcurve_iterations_with_projection.gif", animation = anim_proj)
```

GPLVM:

```{r}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Toy 1D GPLVM with FITC approximation and exact gradient in t
## ------------------------------------------------------------

library(stats)
library(ggplot2)

## 1. Simulate 2D data lying on a 1D manifold ------------------
f1 <- function(x) 4 * sin(0.5 * pi * x)
f2 <- function(x) 3 * log(x + 0.1) * sin(0.3 * pi * x)

set.seed(123)
n      <- 400
t_true <- seq(0, 2, length.out = n)
x1     <- f1(t_true) + rnorm(n, sd = 0.1)
x2     <- f2(t_true) + rnorm(n, sd = 0.1)

Y  <- cbind(x1, x2)             # N x D
Y  <- scale(Y, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
N  <- nrow(Y)
D  <- ncol(Y)

## 2. SE kernel (1D inputs) ------------------------------------
se_kernel <- function(t1, t2, log_ell, log_var) {
  ell <- exp(log_ell)
  var <- exp(log_var)
  t1  <- as.numeric(t1)
  t2  <- as.numeric(t2)
  dist2 <- outer(t1, t2, FUN = function(a, b) (a - b)^2)
  var * exp(-0.5 * dist2 / ell^2)
}

## 3. Hyper-parameters (fixed here, can be optimised later) ----
log_ell   <- log(0.5)   # length-scale
log_var   <- log(1)     # signal variance
log_sigma <- log(0.1)   # noise sd

## 4. Initialise latent t via PCA, choose inducing points ------

pc1    <- prcomp(Y, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)$x[, 1]
t_init <- as.numeric(scale(pc1))

M   <- 10                          # number of inducing points
qs  <- seq(0, 1, length.out = M)   # pick quantiles along t_init
t_u <- as.numeric(quantile(t_init, probs = qs, type = 8))

K_mm     <- se_kernel(t_u, t_u, log_ell, log_var)
L_mm     <- chol(K_mm)
K_mm_inv <- chol2inv(L_mm)

## 5. FITC negative log-likelihood + exact grad wrt t ----------

gplvm_fitc_nll_grad_t <- function(t_latent, Y,
                                  t_u, K_mm_inv,
                                  log_ell, log_var, log_sigma) {
  N <- length(t_latent)
  D <- ncol(Y)

  ell    <- exp(log_ell)
  var    <- exp(log_var)         # signal variance σ_f^2
  sigma2 <- exp(2 * log_sigma)   # noise variance

  # K_NM: N x M
  K_nm <- se_kernel(t_latent, t_u, log_ell, log_var)

  # diag(K_NN) = var
  K_nn_diag <- rep(var, N)

  # Q = K_nm K_mm^{-1} K_mn
  B <- K_mm_inv %*% t(K_nm)        # M x N
  Q <- K_nm %*% B                  # N x N

  # diag correction Λ
  Q_diag      <- rowSums(K_nm * t(B))  # diag(Q)
  Lambda_diag <- K_nn_diag - Q_diag + sigma2

  # Σ = Q + diag(Λ)
  Sigma <- Q
  diag(Sigma) <- diag(Sigma) + Lambda_diag

  # Cholesky of Σ
  chol_Sigma <- tryCatch(chol(Sigma), error = function(e) NA)
  if (anyNA(chol_Sigma)) {
    return(list(value = 1e10, grad = rep(0, N)))
  }

  # log |Σ|
  logdet_Sigma <- 2 * sum(log(diag(chol_Sigma)))

  # Σ^{-1} Y
  alpha <- backsolve(chol_Sigma, forwardsolve(chol_Sigma, Y))
  quad_term <- sum(Y * alpha)     # tr(Y^T Σ^{-1} Y)

  nll <- 0.5 * (D * logdet_Sigma + quad_term + N * D * log(2 * pi))

  ## ---- exact gradient wrt t_latent ----

  Sigma_inv <- chol2inv(chol_Sigma)

  # G = 1/2 ( D Σ^{-1} - Σ^{-1} Y Y^T Σ^{-1} )
  A_mat <- alpha %*% t(alpha)           # Σ^{-1} Y Y^T Σ^{-1}
  G <- 0.5 * (D * Sigma_inv - A_mat)    # N x N

  # dL/dQ = H = G - diag(diag(G))
  diagG <- diag(G)
  H <- G - diag(diagG)

  # dL/dK_nm = 2 H K_nm K_mm^{-1}
  G_K <- 2 * H %*% K_nm %*% K_mm_inv    # N x M

  # dK_nm/dt_i: ∂k(t_i,u_j)/∂t_i = k(t_i,u_j) * (u_j - t_i)/ell^2
  diff_mat <- outer(t_latent, t_u, FUN = function(a, b) b - a)  # (u_j - t_i)
  dK_dt <- K_nm * (diff_mat / (ell^2))                          # N x M

  # grad_t_i = Σ_j G_K[i,j] * dK_dt[i,j]
  grad_t <- rowSums(G_K * dK_dt)

  list(value = nll, grad = grad_t)
}

## 6. Wrap for optim (L-BFGS-B) -------------------------------

fitc_obj <- function(t_par) {
  out <- gplvm_fitc_nll_grad_t(
    t_latent  = t_par,
    Y         = Y,
    t_u       = t_u,
    K_mm_inv  = K_mm_inv,
    log_ell   = log_ell,
    log_var   = log_var,
    log_sigma = log_sigma
  )
  attr(out$value, "grad") <- out$grad
  out$value
}

set.seed(1)
fit <- optim(
  par     = t_init,
  fn      = function(p) fitc_obj(p),
  gr      = function(p) attr(fitc_obj(p), "grad"),
  method  = "L-BFGS-B",
  control = list(maxit = 200)
)

fit$convergence   # 0 means converged
t_fitc <- fit$par

## 7. Simple check / visualization -----------------------------

df_latent <- data.frame(
  t_true = t_true,
  t_pca  = as.numeric(scale(t_init)),
  t_fitc = as.numeric(scale(t_fitc))
)

df_long <- reshape2::melt(df_latent, id.vars = "t_true",
                          variable.name = "method",
                          value.name   = "t_est")

ggplot(df_long, aes(x = t_true, y = t_est, color = method)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "True t",
    y = "Estimated latent coordinate",
    color = "Method",
    title = "PCA vs 1D GPLVM (FITC approximation)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(grid)

## 假设已有：
## Y        : N x 2 数据矩阵
## t_fitc   : 长度 N 的 GPLVM latent (FITC 优化得到)
## se_kernel, log_ell, log_var, log_sigma 同前

N <- nrow(Y)
D <- ncol(Y)
stopifnot(D == 2)

sigma2 <- exp(2 * log_sigma)

# 1. 用 GPLVM latent t_fitc 做一次 GP regression，算 posterior mean
#    K_tt: N x N
K_tt <- se_kernel(t_fitc, t_fitc, log_ell, log_var)
Ky   <- K_tt + sigma2 * diag(N)

chol_Ky <- chol(Ky)

# Σ^{-1} Y
alpha <- backsolve(chol_Ky, forwardsolve(chol_Ky, Y))  # N x 2

# 在一个更平滑的 grid 上画曲线
t_grid <- seq(min(t_fitc), max(t_fitc), length.out = 200)

# K_*t: 200 x N
K_star <- se_kernel(t_grid, t_fitc, log_ell, log_var)

# posterior mean: 200 x 2
F_hat <- K_star %*% alpha
colnames(F_hat) <- c("X1_hat", "X2_hat")

curve_df_gplvm <- data.frame(
  X1 = F_hat[, 1],
  X2 = F_hat[, 2],
  t  = t_grid
)

# 为点的着色，把 t_fitc 缩放到 [0,1]
t_scaled <- (t_fitc - min(t_fitc)) / (max(t_fitc) - min(t_fitc))

df_gplvm <- data.frame(
  X1          = Y[, 1],
  X2          = Y[, 2],
  t_scaled    = t_scaled
)

# 2. 画图：模仿你 p-curve 那张图的风格
ggplot(df_gplvm, aes(x = X1, y = X2, color = t_scaled)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_path(
    data = curve_df_gplvm,
    aes(x = X1, y = X2),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 1.0,
    color = "black",
    arrow = arrow(
      length = unit(0.2, "cm"),
      ends   = "last",
      type   = "closed"
    )
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    name   = "GPLVM index",
    option = "plasma",
    begin  = 0, end = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "X1",
    y = "X2",
    title = "GPLVM (1D latent, FITC approximation)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )
```
